title: The Gerund in Formal Writing
goal: Use the gerund only for simultaneous, manner and immediately prior actions, and replace the two uses the norm rejects.
grammar: the gerund and the written norm

items: I can use the gerund for an action at the same time as the main verb or for the way it happens.
I can replace a gerund of a later action with *y* and a finite verb (*salió y llegó*).
I can replace a gerund after a noun with a *que* clause (*una carta que contiene…*).
